items.summary: Pipeline view takes almost a minute to load when filtered by closing date.
items.customer_impact: Loan officers at Harbor Credit Union stopped using the filter and scroll instead.

items.summary: Summit Home Loans asked whether borrower documents can sync automatically to their Encompass instance.
items.customer_impact: They currently download and re-upload documents manually.

items.summary: Prospect Prairie Mortgage asks whether the borrower portal supports Spanish.
items.customer_impact: They serve many Spanish-speaking borrowers and the deal is in its final stage.

items.summary: Pipeline filters, especially date filters, are very slow for Lakeside Lending.
No one can log in to the borrower portal since this morning and borrowers see an error page.
items.customer_impact: Harbor Credit Union's closings today are blocked.

items.summary: Northgate Bank says something with documents isn't working right.
items.clarifying_question: What exactly is the customer trying to do with documents, what happens instead, and in which part of the product (e.g., upload, viewing, borrower portal)?

items.summary: Summit Home Loans again asked about pushing documents to Encompass.
items.customer_impact: Their ops lead says the manual step costs them hours a week.

items.summary: Filtering the pipeline by date range is very slow, taking 40+ seconds.
Borrowers at Lakeside Lending ask whether they can upload documents from their phone.
items.customer_impact: Borrowers currently have to email photos to the loan officer.

items.summary: Coastal Mortgage asks 'Can we change it?' without saying what.
items.clarifying_question: What specifically does the customer want to change, and where in the product?

themes.summary: Three customers report very slow loan pipeline filtering by date (up to about a minute), with users avoiding the filter or frustrated.
Summit Home Loans wants borrower documents pushed or synced automatically to Encompass instead of manual download and re-upload, which costs hours weekly.
